Methods

Specific ways of carrying out an operation. Each method says when to use it, and lists the protocols that use it.

Read preprocessing

  • Amplicon primer trimming

    Remove primer sequence from amplicon-based reads using a primer scheme.

    iVar trim

  • Quality and adapter trimming

    Trim adapter sequence and low-quality bases from reads.

    fastp · Trimmomatic

Site masking

  • Custom masking

    Mask regions you define yourself in a BED file, such as genes known to be unreliable for your species.

    BEDTools

  • Mobile element masking

    Mask prophages, insertion sequences, and other mobile elements in a bacterial reference.

    PHASTEST · ISEScan

  • Repeat and paralog masking

    Mask repetitive and duplicated regions of a reference so reads cannot map ambiguously.

    MUMmer (nucmer self-alignment) · RepeatMasker

Genome assembly and variant calling

  • De novo assembly

    Assemble each sample's genome from its reads alone, without a reference.

    SPAdes (rnaviralSPAdes) · MEGAHIT · QUAST (assembly assessment)

  • Reference-based SNP calling

    Map reads to a reference, call SNPs, and combine samples into a core SNP alignment of positions present in every sample.

    Snippy · CFSAN SNP Pipeline

  • Reference-based consensus calling

    Map reads to a reference and write a complete consensus sequence for each sample, including indels.

    iVar consensus

  • Reference-free SNP calling

    Identify SNPs shared across samples directly from split k-mers, without a reference genome.

    SKA

Genome alignment

  • Multiple sequence alignment

    Align per-sample genome sequences so equivalent positions line up, optionally anchored to a reference to standardize coordinates.

    MAFFT · Nextclade (reference-guided) · minimap2 + gofasta (reference-guided)

Recombination filtering

  • Clonal frame inference

    Model recombination along a fixed tree with a hidden Markov model and infer the clonal genealogy.

    ClonalFrameML

  • Iterative recombination detection

    Alternate between tree building and detecting regions of elevated SNP density until the result converges.

    Gubbins

Phylogenetic inference

  • Bayesian phylogeny

    Jointly estimate a time-scaled tree, molecular clock, and population model, with uncertainty on every estimate.

    BEAST X · BEAST 2

  • Maximum likelihood phylogeny

    Find the tree that best explains the alignment under a substitution model, with branch lengths in substitutions per site.

    IQ-TREE · RAxML-NG

  • Time-scaled phylogeny

    Rescale an existing tree, usually a maximum likelihood tree, so branch lengths are in time and ancestral nodes are dated.

    TreeTime · LSD2 (in IQ-TREE)
